title: chore(console): refresh vendored objectui SPA to 9aec6817
body:
## What

Refresh the vendored `@object-ui/console` SPA pinned in `.objectui-sha` from `144ab55b` → `9aec6817` (13 upstream commits) and ship the changeset that bumps `@objectstack/console` (minor).

## Upstream changes pulled in

- feat(studio): Data pillar Validations + Settings views (builder-ui Phase B) (#2180)
- feat(studio): package switcher + inline new-writable-package in the top bar (#2173)
- feat(home,studio): builder cover on Home + builder→app bridge; builder landing joins the login journey (#2175, #2176)
- fix(app-shell): stop double-toasting failed script/modal action errors (#2177); don't show recovery-password reminder on SSO-enforced envs or first landing (#2183, #2184)
- fix(plugin-grid): row-selection sync on bulk-action dialog close (#2172); i18n bulk-action dialog (#2171); readable import preview (#2170)
- fix(form): de-emphasize field labels so fieldGroups hierarchy reads (#2174)

## Verification

- `pnpm run build` (70/70) → `scripts/build-console.sh` at `9aec6817` → 35/35 turbo tasks green, dist 42076 KB.
- Bundle canary `import/jobs` present — THIS framework's `@objectstack/client` is injected into the SPA.
- `check:console-sha` gate passes (dist stamp matches pin).
- `packages/console/dist` is gitignored and rebuilt in CI at publish.
